pages.title: Benign Fluff
pages.text: Not tied to a race: one of the 16 songs of the game's CD Player. Between races the menu reads Next Race, Shop, CD Player. Skitchin' (EA, 1994), Mega Drive / Genesis. Music by Jeff van Dyck.

pages.title: Pick a tune
pages.text: Mean Machines Sega noted EA made 'quite a big deal' of the 16 tunes to choose from, and was not impressed: 'the concept isn't exactly new'.

pages.title: Graffiti
pages.text: For the graffiti the team photographed walls around Toronto and called a number found on one. The painters, Carlos Zelaya, Zack Benwell and Nelson Garcia, were too young to drive, so they met at a train station.
